title.zh: 药物滥用（认可机构）公告 2018

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Misuse of Drugs (Approved Institutions) Notification 2018 and comes into operation on 1 July 2018.
2. The Minister declares the places set out in the Schedule to be approved institutions for the purpose of the treatment and rehabilitation of drug addicts and other persons under the Act.
